name: Oxford Economics
description:
The Oxford Economics MCP connector gives Claude access to Oxford Economics’ research, reports, and economic data and forecasts, helping users answer questions about economies, markets, sectors, and regions with trusted insight.

The connector includes two tools: EconomicAnalysis, which provides narrative answers grounded in Oxford Economics reports and research, and EconomicData, which returns numerical economic data and forecasts for single indicators or cross-region comparisons. Use it to generate concise explanations, summaries, report-backed analysis, assumptions, risks, conclusions, and data tables from Oxford Economics sources.

Contact Oxford Economics about upgrading your organisation's account for MCP access: https://www.oxfordeconomics.com/ai-data-solutions/

_published_faq.name: How do I add Oxford Economics to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Oxford Economics to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://services.oxfordeconomics.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Oxford Economics MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Oxford Economics provides these MCP tools: EconomicAnalysis and EconomicData.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Oxford Economics?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Oxford Economics in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.

_published_faq.name: Does Oxford Economics MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Oxford Economics requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Oxford Economics is developed by Oxford Economics. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
